long_description:
This stunning Victorian property has been lovingly transformed into a boutique-style escape where period charm meets contemporary luxury.
Set high above Dolgellau, it offers sweeping views across the rooftops to the dramatic slopes of Cadair Idris, a constant reminder that you’re in the heart of Snowdonia National Park. Spread across four elegant floors, this magnificent home sleeps up to 16 guests in style, making it the ultimate retreat for family celebrations, get-togethers with friends, or milestone occasions. Every detail has been designed with comfort and indulgence in mind. Inside, you’ll find a designer kitchen that makes holiday cooking a joy, a spacious sitting room with a glowing wood-burner, and themed bedrooms, many with luxurious en-suites. For added glamour, the master bedroom even boasts a freestanding slipper bath positioned by the window so you can soak while gazing out at the mountains. The lower floor is a haven of entertainment, featuring a private cinema room, a games room suitable for all ages, and a bar for relaxed evenings. Step outside, and the wow-factor continues: a huge sun terrace with glass balustrades is perfect for al fresco dining and long summer evenings. Sink into the bubbling hot tub, fire up the barbecue, or gather around the fire pit as the sun sets over Snowdonia, the perfect setting for memories that last a lifetime.
Although it feels wonderfully tucked away, you’re just a short stroll from Dolgellau’s historic centre, with its welcoming pubs, independent shops, and monthly farmers’ market. Miles of scenic walking and cycling trails start on your doorstep, including the Mawddach Trail leading to Barmouth’s sandy beaches, just a 20-minute drive away. Adventurers will find mountain hikes, bike parks and heritage sites within easy reach, while those seeking a gentler pace can explore charming Welsh towns, castles, and coastlines all within an hour’s drive. With its blend of heritage and modern luxury, unrivalled facilities, and unbeatable location, this Premier Family Retreat is much more than just a holiday home; it’s a place to gather, celebrate, and experience Snowdonia in unforgettable style.

long_description:
Located in the popular Craig-y-Don area of Llandudno, Curzon Family House is an impressive and beautifully renovated home designed for memorable group holidays on the North Wales coast. Sleeping up to eighteen guests across ten bedrooms, this spacious, pet-friendly property is ideal for extended families, groups of friends and special celebrations.
Inside, generous social spaces give everyone plenty of room to spend time together without ever feeling crowded. The comfortable living area provides a welcoming setting for relaxed evenings, while the well-equipped kitchen makes catering for a large group straightforward. Gather around the dining table for leisurely breakfasts, celebratory meals or drinks as you plan the next day’s adventures.
Curzon has ten thoughtfully presented bedrooms, including three king-size rooms, five doubles and two singles. Eight bedrooms benefit from private en-suite facilities, while the remaining two share a bathroom. One en-suite bedroom is conveniently located on the ground floor, making it a practical option for guests with limited mobility. Every bedroom also has its own flat-screen television with streaming services and complimentary Netflix.
Entertainment is well covered in the dedicated games room, where guests can challenge each other to air hockey or electronic darts, play on the PlayStation 4 or rediscover favourites on the retro gaming machines. Fast Wi-Fi is available throughout the house. Outside, the private hot tub offers the perfect place to unwind after a day beside the sea, while the garden and patio provide additional space for relaxing in the fresh coastal air.
Craig-y-Don combines the convenience of a thriving neighbourhood with easy access to Llandudno’s famous seafront. The promenade is only a short walk away and provides a wonderful route around the sweeping bay, with views extending across the water towards the Little Orme. Families can visit the nearby paddling pool and play areas or spend time on North Shore Beach.
Local cafés, shops, pubs and restaurants are within walking distance, while Venue Cymru hosts a varied programme of theatre, comedy, music and live entertainment. Continue along the promenade to reach the heart of Llandudno, where traditional seaside attractions include the Victorian pier, amusement arcades and independent shops.
The Great Orme is one of the town’s unmissable landmarks, offering spectacular coastal views, scenic walking routes and opportunities to travel by historic tramway or cable car. Guests can also explore the quieter West Shore Beach or enjoy the landscaped surroundings of Happy Valley Gardens.
Historic Conwy is just a short drive away, where visitors can discover its magnificent medieval castle, walk the ancient town walls and explore the picturesque quayside. Farther afield, Bodnant Garden, Betws-y-Coed and the mountains of Eryri National Park offer unforgettable days among forests, lakes and dramatic peaks. With outstanding group accommodation, private leisure facilities and Llandudno’s attractions close by, Curzon is a superb setting for a fun-filled North Wales escape.

long_description:
Set in a stunning coastal location on the beautiful Llŷn Peninsula, this spacious farmhouse is the perfect escape for large families and groups of friends. Sleeping up to 18 guests across eight comfortable bedrooms and four bathrooms, the house offers generous living spaces, spectacular surroundings, and everything you need for a memorable stay on the North Wales coast.
Designed with comfort and practicality in mind, the farmhouse includes a convenient ground floor bedroom with a modern wet room located next door, making it an excellent choice for guests with reduced mobility or anyone wishing to avoid stairs. The remaining bedrooms are spread across the upper floor, with several enjoying breathtaking views across the sea, providing the perfect way to wake up each morning.
The heart of the home is the spacious open plan kitchen and dining room, where everyone can gather to cook, dine, and spend quality time together. Fully equipped for large groups, it provides plenty of seating, making everything from relaxed breakfasts to celebratory evening meals a pleasure. After a day of exploring, unwind in the welcoming lounge, where a cosy log burner creates the perfect atmosphere during cooler evenings. Sink into the comfortable sofas, enjoy a film, play games, or simply relax beside the fire.
Outside, the farmhouse continues to impress. The private hot tub offers an unforgettable place to soak while taking in panoramic sea views and spectacular sunsets over Cardigan Bay. Whether you’re enjoying your morning coffee outdoors or relaxing beneath the stars after a day at the beach, the peaceful setting makes every moment special.
One of the property’s greatest attractions is its exceptional location. Just a five minute walk away lies the magnificent Porth Neigwl, better known as Hell’s Mouth Beach. Stretching for almost four miles, this spectacular sandy beach is famous for its dramatic scenery, rolling surf, and wide-open spaces. It is popular with surfers, paddleboarders, walkers, families, and dog owners, offering endless opportunities to enjoy the coastline throughout the year.
The charming seaside village of Abersoch is only a short 10 minute drive away. Renowned for its boutique shops, excellent restaurants, cafés, welcoming pubs, and vibrant marina, Abersoch is one of North Wales’ most sought after holiday destinations. Spend your days browsing independent shops, enjoying fresh seafood overlooking the harbour, or taking part in watersports on its sheltered beaches.
The farmhouse also provides the perfect base for discovering everything the spectacular Llŷn Peninsula has to offer. Explore the picturesque fishing village of Aberdaron, visit the National Trust’s beautiful Plas yn Rhiw, enjoy breathtaking coastal walks along the Wales Coast Path, or take a boat trip to Bardsey Island to spot seals, dolphins, and an abundance of seabirds. Nearby beaches including Llanbedrog, Porth Ceiriad, Porthor (Whistling Sands), and Morfa Nefyn each offer their own unique beauty, while golfers can enjoy the famous clifftop course at Nefyn & District Golf Club.
This exceptional farmhouse combines space, comfort, spectacular scenery, and an unbeatable location.

long_description:
A high-quality property that accommodates 16 guests and dog friendly situated in Llandegla in the county of Denbighshire (northeast Wales). This spectacular property was a former country hotel and is also a licensed wedding venue, you could combine a holiday with a wedding ceremony! The property has its own bar and can be stocked at your request.
The property consists of a large open plan living area with wood burner, high quality furnishings and sofas, it is open plan with the large dining area which has a large dining table to sit all guests, there is also a bar area within this room with bar stools. The kitchen has absolutely everything you could possibly need, including a four oven Aga, juice maker, professional coffee machine, smoothie maker, fridge/freezer with water and ice dispenser and a large breakfast bar. On the ground floor are double toilets with baby changing facilities and electric hand dryers. The utility area has fridge/freezer, washing machine and tumble dryer. There are two bedrooms on the ground floor with wheelchair access and ramp, Deer Room has a kingsize sleigh bed and is en-suite with walk-in shower and French doors overlooking Coed Llandegla and its rolling hills. The Hare Room has a super kingsize zip and link bed with two armchairs and is en-suite with bath and rainfall shower.
To the first floor there are three further bedrooms, The Partridge Room with mountain views, has a kingsize sleigh bed and en-suite with double ended roll top bath and a large walk-in rainfall shower. The Lord Grousemoor has a super kingsize bed, two armchairs and an en-suite with double ended roll top bath and rainfall shower. The Woodcock Room has a kingsize bed with an en-suite with a large walk-in rainfall shower. There is also a two-bedroom suite on the first floor: The Pheasant Suite consists of a twin room with views over the heather topped Welsh hills, with en-suite shower over the bath. The master suite with dual aspect windows and views over the hills and forest has a super kingsize zip and link bed. The Pheasant Suite also has its own living room and kitchen with ceramic hob, washing machine, dishwasher and fridge. All rooms have bathrobes, toiletries and mending kits provided. To the rear of the property is a large terrace with garden furniture and fabulous views over the Welsh countryside, two gas barbecues, two showers, three toilets and an outdoor sink.
There is plenty to see and do in the area, the property is right on the Offa’s Dyke trail, so great for walkers or cyclists. There is also mountain biking in Coed Llandegla (One Planet), clay pigeon shooting at Fauxdegla, off road motor safari and white-water rafting. Llangollen is 9 miles from the property and offers a great day out to the Horseshoe Pass and falls, the castle ruins at Castell Dinas Bran has some stunning views from the top. Restaurant ¼ mile.
